clue.text: People a priest's about to have sex with

indicators.note: 'is about' here means one letter now stands as the abbreviation for circa, so it is swapped for that letter

parts.note: to people a place is to populate it
P is an abbreviation for priest; 'a' says just one of the two Ps changes
c. (circa) means about

explanation.surface: A cleric is about to be intimate with members of his flock: a scandal in the making.
explanation.walkthrough: The verb POPULATE has its first P (priest) replaced by C (about), giving COPULATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Copulating is the formal word for sexual intercourse, so it replaces the phrase in a sentence such as 'they copulate with'.

clue.text: Perhaps 8 ball initially caught by its player's equipment

indicators.note: being caught by something means being held in it

parts.note: a snooker or pool player uses a cue

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so only the first letter is taken

parts.note: its first letter

explanation.surface: The 8-ball at pool, struck first by a cue.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is not a cross-reference here: it is the number, the cube of 2. The surface makes it look like the black 8-ball in pool.
explanation.definitionFit: Eight is two multiplied by itself three times, so it is an example of a cube number.

clue.text: Summit talk starts late

indicators.note: starting late means missing the opening, so the first letter is lost

parts.note: speak means talk

explanation.surface: Discussions at a summit meeting get under way behind schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: A peak is the highest point of a mountain, just as a summit is.

clue.text: Wine producer learnt glut ends once regular characters leave

indicators.note: every second letter of the phrase drops out, leaving the alternate ones

explanation.surface: A winemaker who has learnt that a surplus ends things.
explanation.walkthrough: Keep the first, third, fifth and every other letter of 'learnt glut ends once'.
explanation.definitionFit: Languedoc is a large region of southern France famous for its vineyards and wine output.

clue.text: Try to correct call in parliament supporting transitive monetary units

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means standing underneath, so the owl's call is placed below the rest

parts.note: T is a dictionary abbreviation for transitive
the rouble is the Russian currency
a parliament is the collective noun for owls, whose call is a hoot

explanation.surface: An MP tries to correct a ruling about money with a shout in the chamber.
explanation.walkthrough: Parliament is not Westminster but a group of owls. In a down clue 'supporting' puts the owl's call beneath the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To troubleshoot is to trace and fix faults, so it means to try to put something right.

clue.text: Gadget finding husbands for daughters creates excitement

indicators.note: finding one thing for another means putting it in the other's place throughout

parts.note: a doodad is a gadget or gizmo
H is the abbreviation for husband
D is the abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: A dating gadget that pairs daughters with husbands causes a stir in the family.
explanation.walkthrough: Every D of DOODAD becomes H, giving HOOHAH.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoo-hah is a fuss or commotion, a slangy word for a burst of excited agitation.

clue.text: After goalless draw the man had sounded pleased

parts.note: a goalless draw is 0-0
he'd is the contraction of 'he had'

explanation.surface: After a goalless draw, a fan seemed pleased with the result.
explanation.definitionFit: To ooh is to make an exclamation of delight or admiration, so oohed means voiced pleasure.

clue.text: Complicated case of herpes, so I ran it past experts

indicators.note: something complicated is tangled, so the letters are mixed into a new order
a case is an outer shell, so only the outside letters are kept

parts.note: the outer letters
taken letter for letter
taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A tricky case of herpes, so I put it before the experts.
explanation.definitionFit: Historians are scholars of what has gone before, so they are experts on the past.

clue.text: Seconds away from late run on Echo cutting journalist's top line

indicators.note: these pieces cut into the word for journalist

parts.note: a hack is a journalist

indicators.note: the second letter of each word goes, A from late and U from run

parts.note: E is Echo in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: A tardy reporter rushing to cut the headline of a newspaper item.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top line' looks like a headline; it is the neckline of a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A halterneck is a style of women's top whose strap goes round the back of the neck.

clue.text: One's clever gift of lingerie?

parts.note: a bra is an item of lingerie
a gift comes wrapped up in a box

explanation.surface: A boxed present of underwear for someone bright.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the whimsy: a present of lingerie would be a bra in a box, and those words run together name a clever person.
explanation.definitionFit: A brainbox is informal British slang for an intelligent person, so the noun stands for a person who is clever.

clue.text: Charlie periodically sleeps with recurrent cheat

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO alphabet

indicators.note: recurrent is read as running back, so the kept letters are taken in the opposite direction
something done periodically happens at regular intervals, so every other letter is kept

parts.note: the even-placed letters of these two words

explanation.surface: Charlie is a serial adulterer, a cheat who keeps sleeping around.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of 'sleeps with' read backwards give HISEL, after C.
explanation.definitionFit: To chisel is informal for to swindle, so it means to cheat someone out of something.

clue.text: Listing Roger and Stacy exposed to me?

definitions.meaning: setter's reading: sorting things into groups, as names are filed under headings

definitions.text: Roger and Stacy exposed to me?
definitions.meaning: surface reading: two named people revealed to the speaker

explanation.walkthrough: Stripped of outer letters, Stacy and Roger leave TAC and OGE, which read backwards start the answer; the ending may be I (me) plus SING (expose), but the clue gives no clear indicators.
explanation.definitionFit: Categorising is sorting items into classes, which is what drawing up a list under headings does.

clue.text: Deviously cover up a bold and cynical show of affection

indicators.note: doing something deviously means by a twisted route, so the letters are arranged crookedly

parts.note: the fodder, taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: Someone slyly hides a brazen act, and a cynical display of affection follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Cupboard love is affection shown only for what one can get, like a pet fawning on whoever opens the food cupboard.

clue.text: Assumption American puritan somehow will take over

parts.note: US is the abbreviation for American

indicators.note: taking something in means holding it among the other letters
somehow says the letters arrive by some unspecified rearrangement

parts.note: the fodder
O is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for an over

explanation.surface: An American puritan will somehow assume control.
explanation.walkthrough: An over is a set of six balls in cricket, written O on scorecards.
explanation.definitionFit: Usurpation is the seizing of power, which is an assumption of a role in the sense of taking it on.

clue.text: Prepares terms

definitions.meaning: first meaning: gets ready, as an athlete or hair is conditioned
second meaning: stipulations of an agreement

explanation.walkthrough: One word read as a verb and then as a plural noun.
explanation.definitionFit: To condition is to train or get ready, and conditions are the provisos laid down in a contract.

clue.text: One has a point about key arguments

indicators.note: about suggests going round, so the last letter is brought round to the front

parts.note: to have words is to argue; key words are the telling ones in a quarrel

explanation.surface: Someone making a point about the central arguments in a debate.
explanation.walkthrough: Moving the final S of WORDS to the front gives SWORD; 'One has a point' is a cryptic description of a sharp blade.
explanation.definitionFit: A sword is a bladed weapon with a sharp tip, so it is literally a thing that has a point.

clue.text: Plan currency in European country after leader is deposed

indicators.note: the currency goes inside the other pieces
once the first letter is removed, like a toppled ruler

parts.note: a nation is a country
the lev is the currency of Bulgaria

explanation.surface: A scheme for money in a European state after its ruler's overthrow.
explanation.walkthrough: An elevation is an architect's drawing of a building's face, which loosely counts as a plan.
explanation.definitionFit: In architecture an elevation is a scale drawing of one side of a building, one of its plans.

clue.text: He used to think she serves coffee naked to upset the French

indicators.note: naked means stripped, so the barista loses her outer letters

parts.note: a barista serves coffee in a café

indicators.note: upset means turned over, so to is reversed in this down answer

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: A barista serving coffee without clothes upsets the French.
explanation.walkthrough: BARISTA stripped is ARIST, then OT (TO 'upset'), then LE.
explanation.definitionFit: Aristotle was the ancient Greek philosopher, a thinker from long ago, which is what 'used to think' means here.

clue.text: Life force essentially supported by awfully acrid vegetable

indicators.note: the jumbled piece comes before the rest
done badly, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: chi, or qi, is the vital energy in Chinese philosophy

indicators.note: the essence of the word is its central letter

explanation.surface: A sharp-tasting vegetable that keeps you going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supported by' reads like a down-clue placing, but this is across: O is the central letter of supported.
explanation.definitionFit: Radicchio is a bitter red-leaved chicory eaten in salads.

clue.text: Mention I construct housing of Greek style

indicators.note: housing means holding inside, so the run of letters is lodged within the words

parts.note: lettered across the end of the first word, the next word, and the start of the third

explanation.surface: Someone says they'll build a house in the Greek manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Ionic is one of the classical orders of Greek architecture, marked by scroll-shaped capitals.

clue.text: Solarists got confused with these?

indicators.note: confused letters are mixed up, so they must be put in a new order

parts.note: the fodder, every letter used

explanation.surface: Sun-worshippers are easily mistaken for those who read the stars.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: people who believe the sun's position shapes lives might well be mixed up with star-readers.
explanation.definitionFit: Astrologers study the sun's and planets' positions, so sun-focused believers are easily confused with them.

clue.text: Perhaps boxer cycles against pianist and composer

indicators.note: cycling means going round, so the first letter moves to the end

parts.note: a boxer is a breed of dog
leaning against something is leaning on it

explanation.surface: A boxer rides a bike in opposition to a musician.
explanation.walkthrough: Boxer is a dog breed, not a fighter. John Ogdon was a British concert pianist who also composed.
explanation.definitionFit: John Ogdon won the 1962 Tchaikovsky Competition and wrote music himself, making him both a performer and a composer.

clue.text: Retired judge providing island country

indicators.note: retired means drawn back, so the letters go in reverse order

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for judge
providing means on condition that, which is if
I is the abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: A retired judge supplies an island nation, perhaps to settle there.
explanation.definitionFit: Fiji is a sovereign Pacific nation made up of islands, so it is a country.

clue.text: Singular example of game

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for singular
tag is a children's chasing game

explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue also defines: a male deer is a single beast hunted as game.
explanation.definitionFit: A stag is a male deer, and deer are hunted as game, so one stag is an instance of game.

clue.text: Part of opera was created earlier we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the sound of the words matters, not their spelling

parts.note: anything created earlier is old

explanation.surface: A section of an opera was written before the rest, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: Part here means a role: Isolde is the heroine of Wagner's Tristan und Isolde.
explanation.definitionFit: A part in an opera is a singing role, and Isolde is the soprano role in Wagner's opera.

clue.text: Precinct detective following rules to the letter

parts.note: DI is Detective Inspector
strict rules are applied exactly as written

explanation.surface: A police precinct where a detective goes strictly by the book.
explanation.definitionFit: A precinct is an administrative area of a city, the same idea as a district.

clue.text: Rounded projection numbers reversing national insurance guarantees primarily

parts.note: nos is the abbreviation for numbers

indicators.note: reversing means running backwards, so the abbreviation is turned round

parts.note: its first letter

explanation.surface: A report on how statistics for social-security contributions secure guarantees.
explanation.definitionFit: A nosing is the rounded edge of a stair tread that juts out over the riser.

clue.text: A diver abandoned by bachelor in Grand at one

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: to be abandoned by someone is to lose them, so that letter goes

parts.note: the grebe is a diving water bird
B is the abbreviation for bachelor
taken as written
G is short for grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A diver left behind by a single man in a grand hotel, at one with the world.
explanation.walkthrough: In crosswords 'diver' is often a bird, here the grebe; a G is a grand, a thousand pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: To be at one is to be in harmony, the same as agreeing with someone.
